attributes.name: Soltengrebbe
attributes.powers:
Soltengrebbe is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. If you succeed at a Knowledge 10 check, add 4 to your checks against Soltengrebbe that have the Attack, Cold, or Fire trait.

Before you act, Soltengrebbe deals 1d4 Cold damage to each character at your location.

If undefeated, Soltengrebbe deals 1d4 Combat damage to 3 random characters at your location.
